# Kondō 1986 Enriques source

`ko1821.pdf` is the Nagoya dissertation copy of *Enriques Surfaces with
Finite Automorphism Groups*: [repository record](https://nagoya.repo.nii.ac.jp/records/4843),
[journal DOI](https://doi.org/10.4099/math1924.12.191). It has 147 PDF pages,
9875342 bytes and SHA-256
`57be54fdd5e95324fe870f0fb69fc406022c4a13459e4a94de290a8d2fac6204`.

The historical audit uses the Main Theorem/curve counts on internal pp. 3–7,
Vinberg's specialized criterion on p. 12 and the no-hidden-nodal-curves
statement on p. 13. Interrupted downloads were not retained.

[Detailed source scope](https://sashakolpakov.github.io/CoxeterPolytopes/sources.html#kondo-1986)
· [Retrieval](../../../repro/EXTERNAL_INPUTS.md).
